name: Town District

triggers.label: Talk to Stranger
triggers.tooltip: Approach the cloaked figure standing near the gateway.
triggers.description: A mysterious cloaked stranger stands quietly near the stone archway, watching the road with an observant gaze.

triggers.label: Inspect Outpost Notice Board
triggers.tooltip: Read official postings, local bounties, and advisories from the commander.
triggers.description: A heavy wooden board nailed with parchment notices regarding bandit bounties and wilderness hazards.

triggers.label: Investigate Corrupted Glade
triggers.tooltip: Inspect the blackened earth and withering trees in this secluded clearing.
triggers.description: Vegetation here is twisted by dark necrotic magic. A stone chest half-buried in twisted roots catches your eye.

defaultDescriptions: You are exploring the Town District. Stone-paved paths meander between multi-storey timber buildings and quiet residential avenues.
A refreshing breeze sweeps through the town streets, carrying the scent of woodsmoke, fresh bread, and distant blooming gardens.

1,1: You stand near the northern town gate of the settlement. A grand stone archway spans overhead, framing the cobbled avenue that stretches deeper into the Town District.
The northern gateway is quiet and welcoming. Sturdy iron-bound arch stones rise above you, offering a vantage point across the district's paved roads.
8,1: You arrive before the entrance to a charming, ivy-draped residence known as the Cozy Cottage. A warm glow emanates from behind its curtained front windows.
Standing on the front steps of the Cozy Cottage, a polished wooden door with brass fittings invites you to enter.
2,3: You stand in the Outpost Central Square. A weathered wooden notice board stands near the crossroad connecting the barracks, forge, and apothecary.
The busy square is paved with worn stones, serving as the primary hub for traveling adventurers and outpost sentries.
7,5: The forest grows dark and quiet here. Twisted, blackened branches block out the sun, and the soil is stained with dark arcane residue.
A chilling aura emanates from a corrupted clearing deeper in the woods. Roots coil abnormally around an ancient stone chest.
7,6: You stand before the gaping descent of the Sunken Ruins. Crumbling carved pillars frame a flight of stone stairs sinking into the earth.
Cold air carrying the faint scent of ozone and ancient stone drifts up from the dark stairs leading beneath the valley.

cobblestone: Smooth, rounded cobblestones form the thoroughfare underfoot, worn level by years of foot traffic.
The stone pavement beneath your boots is firm and clean, with neatly fitted curbing running along either side.
high_street: Quaint shopfronts with hanging painted signs flank this bustling section of the town street.
Neat timber-and-plaster buildings with flower boxes overlook this pleasant thoroughfare.
plaza: The street broadens into a modest open plaza, where townfolk often gather around a stone bench.
An open paved square opens up ahead, giving you a clear view of the surrounding rooftops.
residential: Rows of quiet, two-story homes line this peaceful lane, their curtained windows looking out onto the street.
This residential avenue is calm and sheltered, with decorative iron lampposts standing at intervals.
alleyway: A narrow, shadowed passage runs between the tall brick walls of adjoining buildings.
The cool air of this side alley is quiet, offering a secluded shortcut between the main thoroughfares.
central_square: You find yourself near the heart of the district, where multiple avenues converge around paved footways.
The wide central intersection offers pathways leading towards residential quarters and outer thoroughfares alike.
market_quarter: Canopies and stalls of local merchants line the road, their wares neatly arranged for browsing customers.
A lively section of the street frequented by vendors and travelers trading daily provisions.
forest: Dense, shadowed woodlands thick with mossy trunks, undergrowth, and wild creatures.
ruins: Weathered masonry and collapsed stone archways dating back to an ancient arcane civilization.
